package answer

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func newLearningAction(answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, task *TaskMetadata, openedAt time.Time) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	contextType := domain.LearningContextLessonTask
	if isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task) {
		contextType = domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
	}
	evidenceClass, err := learningEvidenceClassForTask(task.Type)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	return domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID,
		StudentID:           answer.StudentID,
		TaskID:              answer.TaskID,
		ContextType:         contextType,
		ContextID:           task.ID,
		LearningTargets:     task.LearningTargets,
		EvidenceClass:       evidenceClass,
		OpenedAt:            openedAt,
	})
}

func closeAnswerLearningAction(
	ctx context.Context,
	lifecycle repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository,
	answers repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository,
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	closedAt time.Time,
) error {
	if lifecycle == nil {
		if answer.LearningPathItemID != "" || answer.RequirementID != "" {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return answers.Update(ctx, answer)
	}
	action, err := lifecycle.GetActiveByAnswer(ctx, answer.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	event, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosedEvent(uuid.NewString(), action, closedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	outcome, err := domain.LearningActionOutcomeForAnswerStatus(answer.Status)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	action.Outcome = outcome
	action.OutcomePolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
	return lifecycle.CloseAnswer(ctx, answer, action, event)
}

func learningEvidenceClassForTask(taskType int16) (domain.LearningEvidenceClass, error) {
	switch taskKindFromType(taskType) {
	case "quiz_theory", "test", "ordering", "classification":
		return domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, nil
	case "frontend_preview", "fullstack_page", "cli_programming", "api_endpoint", "debug_fix",
		"refactor_quality", "git_cli", "sql_query", "practice_task_milestone":
		return domain.LearningEvidenceApplication, nil
	default:
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
}
